tags.instructions: Get the ID from `list-action-items`. Set completed to true to complete it or false to reopen it. Use `archive-action-item` for won't-do instead. This changes existing task state; inspect `get-action-item` before retrying an ambiguous result.

functions.name: update-note
functions.description: Rename an existing note, replace its complete agenda with Fellow Markdown, or do both.

title.description: New note title; omit to preserve it. An empty string requests a blank title, subject to provider validation; null is not accepted.

noteId.description: Opaque identifier of the existing note.

contentFellowMarkdown.description: Complete replacement agenda in Fellow Markdown. Omit to preserve the body; empty string requests clearing it. Not the lossy contentMarkdown display format.

title.description: New note title; omit to preserve it. An empty string requests a blank title, subject to provider validation; null is not accepted.

FunctionInput_fellow_updatenote.description: The existing note identifier and a new title, a complete replacement agenda, or both.

title.description: Authoritative resulting note title, or null.

contentFellowMarkdown.description: Resulting full agenda in editable Fellow Markdown.

FunctionOutput_fellow_updatenote.description: The authoritative updated note title and full editable agenda returned by Fellow.

tags.instructions: Obtain noteId and editable content from `get-note`. Omitted title/body are unchanged; providing a body replaces the entire agenda. Never use contentMarkdown as input. Prefer `append-note-agenda`, `prepend-note-agenda` or `find-replace-note-agenda` for narrow edits. Edit access is required even when you can view the note.
